description: Na₃MoNO₃ is Stannite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MoNO₃ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.39 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MoNO₃ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.35 Å. Mo is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form MoNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Mo-N bond length is 1.75 Å. There is one shorter (1.86 Å) and two longer (1.87 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. N is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form NNa₃Mo tetrahedra that share corners with twelve ONa₃Mo tetrahedra. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form ONa₃Mo tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra and corners with eight ONa₃Mo tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃Mo tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent ONa₃Mo tetrahedra.
